subject: Vector DB partnership sourcing - security & ops checklist
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vector DB partnership sourcing - security & ops checklist

Hi Sabine / Alex / team,

Quick note from Redwood — we're scoping a short evaluation (2-4 weeks) to test vector store fallthrough and prefix-KV cache behavior for a midsize SaaS customer. Before we lock timelines we'd like to align on a small set of operational and security checkpoints so we don't hit surprises mid-trial.

I've attached a short "redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf" that lists the items we usually validate. High level asks:
- Security: SOC2 point-of-contact and a completed questionnaire (or link to a trust center)
- Networking: NAT/egress rules or VPC peering options for the trial workload
- Ops: key metrics (index update latency, query p95 latency under 50 qps), eviction/backpressure behavior
- Demos: short dev walkthrough + perf run during week 1

Can you confirm who on your side would own the security questionnaire and whether you can provide any pre-filled answers (or a pointer to a docs page)? We plan to schedule a 30-min intro call tomorrow to align.

Thanks —
Karthik
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Sabine Krupp <sabine@pinecone.io>

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the checklist. Happy to support the short eval. Attaching a completed tab (vector-sla-qs.xlsx) with our SOC2 dates, encryption-at-rest details, and typical SSO/KMS options. We also have a public trust center: https://pinecone.io/trust that covers most items — I noted the doc links in the attached sheet.

For operations: Sam Patel (sam@pinecone.io) will be our trial lead and can run the perf job you mentioned. Networking-wise, we offer VPC peering in the AWS eu/us regions; I'll confirm the peering steps in a separate note.

We can join a 30-min call at 2:30pm PT today. I put a tentative Zoom in the invite (see link in the calendar).

Best,

> Thanks for the checklist. Happy to support the short eval. Attaching a completed tab (vector-sla-qs.xlsx)...

Thanks Sabine — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of follow-ups from our infra team before the perf run:
- Can you confirm expected cold-start time for new shards when we bulk-index ~10M embeddings? (ballpark is fine)
- What eviction/backpressure signals are exposed via metrics (preferred: queue depth, qps, mem_pressure)?
- If we hit a sustained p95 > 500ms during the perf run, what's the operational fallback you recommend?

Also attaching (sow-trial-draft.docx) — very light draft SOW to align scope, trial duration, and a single pilot success metric (indexing < 60s per 100k embeddings and p95 query < 250ms at 50 qps). Please mark any redlines.

Priyom
